title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #15

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. The soil in a shamba belongs to which element? (1 mark)
   A. Prithvi
   B. Agni
   C. Vayu
   D. Akash

2. What should you do when you join a religious activity of another faith? (1 mark)
   A. Listen carefully and behave politely
   B. Make noise
   C. Refuse to sit
   D. Laugh at it

3. Which of these is a use of water at home? (1 mark)
   A. Cooking food
   B. Making the wind blow
   C. Making rocks
   D. Producing sunlight

4. What was Guru Ram Das Ji's childhood name? (1 mark)
   A. Siddhartha
   B. Ravi
   C. Prahlad
   D. Jetha

5. Where was Hiranyakashipu when Narsimha stopped him? (1 mark)
   A. On a mountain
   B. In a field
   C. At the doorway, neither inside nor outside
   D. On a boat

6. Sri Guru Ram Das Ji was which Guru of the Sikhs? (1 mark)
   A. The fourth
   B. The third
   C. The tenth
   D. The first

7. From where did Narsimha appear in the story? (1 mark)
   A. A river
   B. A pillar in the palace
   C. The sky at noon
   D. A boat

8. What does Asteya mean? (1 mark)
   A. Sing every day
   B. Fast all day
   C. Sit still
   D. Do not take what is not given

9. Which activity helps us remember the teachings of Enlightened Beings? (1 mark)
   A. Reading it silently
   B. Acting a skit of a story
   C. Reading the story aloud twice
   D. Colouring the poster

10. Who declared that Sikhs should follow the Granth as their Guru? (1 mark)
   A. Guru Gobind Singh Ji
   B. Ram
   C. Guru Amar Das Ji
   D. Sigala

11. According to the Dhammapada teachings in the lesson, hatred is ended by what? (1 mark)
   A. More hatred
   B. Silence
   C. Love
   D. Fighting

12. What is Ayodhya Kaand about? (1 mark)
   A. The life of Guru Nanak
   B. Yoga
   C. Ram going to the forest and Bharat's humility
   D. The birth of the Buddha

13. What does the langar teach? (1 mark)
   A. Equality
   B. Pride
   C. Fear
   D. Greed

14. Which of the Sigalovada teachings shows how to treat the people who help us at home or work? (1 mark)
   A. Shout at them
   B. Respect and care for workers and helpers
   C. Pay no attention
   D. Ignore them

15. Which quality of Ram is taught in the Bal Kaand? (1 mark)
   A. Respect for parents and teachers
   B. Pride
   C. Cruelty
   D. Laziness

16. What is the lesson of Bharat refusing the throne? (1 mark)
   A. Be humble and do not be greedy for power
   B. Grab wealth
   C. Never obey
   D. Take what you like

17. What does dravinam mean in the prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Knowledge
   B. Prayer
   C. Wealth
   D. Mother

18. In which Kenyan towns are Mandirs found? (1 mark)
   A. Only in villages
   B. Only Lamu
   C. Nairobi, Mombasa and Kisumu
   D. None

19. Which best describes a person with integrity? (1 mark)
   A. Honest only when watched
   B. Rich
   C. Loud
   D. Honest even when nobody is watching

20. Which Jain teaching means not stealing? (1 mark)
   A. Asteya
   B. Ahimsa
   C. Satya
   D. Aparigraha

21. What does Sadachaar mean? (1 mark)
   A. A holy river
   B. Daily prayer
   C. A festival
   D. Good conduct

22. Who should guide children in yoga? (1 mark)
   A. Nobody
   B. A stranger
   C. A friend who has never tried
   D. A trained teacher or trusted adult

23. Which is a benefit of yoga? (1 mark)
   A. It stops rain
   B. It makes us noisy
   C. It gives instant riches
   D. It helps us breathe well and stay calm

24. Why is yoga best done with an expert? (1 mark)
   A. To be noisy
   B. So no one else can join
   C. To avoid strain from wrong posture
   D. To finish faster

25. Which is a mistake in yoga? (1 mark)
   A. Stopping if unwell
   B. Breathing slowly
   C. Holding the breath for too long
   D. Working with a teacher

26. What is the benefit of Sasankasana? (1 mark)
   A. It is useless
   B. It cures every disease
   C. It makes the arms shorter
   D. It stretches the back and shoulders and relaxes

27. How does Namaste show the idea of Paramatma? (1 mark)
   A. It is a food
   B. It means goodbye only
   C. It is a race
   D. It shows respect for the divine in everyone

28. Which important idea about the Purusharthas is taught? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore Dharma
   B. Balance, with wealth and wishes following Dharma
   C. Wishes come first
   D. Wealth is all that matters

29. What does fasting on Maha Shivratri show? (1 mark)
   A. Self-control
   B. Laziness
   C. Anger
   D. Greed

30. In which months of the usual calendar does Maha Shivratri usually fall? (1 mark)
   A. July or August
   B. October or November
   C. December or January
   D. February or March

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Explain what the Sigalovada Sutta teaches about the six directions. (3 marks)

32. Describe how Maha Shivratri is celebrated. (3 marks)

33. Why should we not bully others, according to the teachings in this lesson? (2 marks)

34. Explain the words Micchami Dukkadam said at Paryushan. (2 marks)

35. Name any four of the five great elements of the Panch Mahabhoot. (2 marks)

36. Describe how Hindu families care for the Tulsi plant. (3 marks)

37. What does the word Panch Mahabhoot mean? (2 marks)

38. Explain why the River Rijubalika is important to Jains. (3 marks)

39. What is Pranayam? (2 marks)

40. What does yoga mean? (2 marks)

41. State two things people do on Maha Shivratri. (2 marks)

42. What is a Tirthankar? (2 marks)

43. Describe the story of King Shibi and the dove and give its lesson. (4 marks)

44. Write three ways of conserving water in the community. (3 marks)

45. Who was Sri Guru Ram Das Ji's teacher and predecessor? (2 marks)

46. What is the role of the bell in a Mandir? (2 marks)

47. Why are Enlightened Beings considered inspiring? Use two examples. (5 marks)

48. What does Dainik Prarthana mean? (2 marks)

49. List four facts about the planets linked with the days. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #15 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Prithvi
   Soil is earth, or Prithvi.

2. A — Listen carefully and behave politely
   We show respect to all faiths.

3. A — Cooking food
   We use water for cooking, drinking and washing.

4. D — Jetha
   His childhood name was Jetha.

5. C — At the doorway, neither inside nor outside
   Narsimha stopped him at the threshold.

6. A — The fourth
   He came after Guru Amar Das Ji.

7. B — A pillar in the palace
   The pillar broke open and he appeared.

8. D — Do not take what is not given
   Asteya means not stealing.

9. B — Acting a skit of a story
   A skit helps us learn the lesson.

10. A — Guru Gobind Singh Ji
   He was the tenth Guru.

11. C — Love
   Hatred is not ended by hatred but by love.

12. C — Ram going to the forest and Bharat's humility
   It tells of Ram's fourteen years away from the kingdom.

13. A — Equality
   Everyone sits side by side to eat.

14. B — Respect and care for workers and helpers
   Workers are one of the six directions.

15. A — Respect for parents and teachers
   Ram was truthful, polite and brave.

16. A — Be humble and do not be greedy for power
   He knew the throne belonged to Ram.

17. C — Wealth
   Dravinam means wealth.

18. C — Nairobi, Mombasa and Kisumu
   Mandirs are found in many Kenyan towns.

19. D — Honest even when nobody is watching
   Integrity is honesty at all times.

20. A — Asteya
   Asteya is non-stealing.

21. D — Good conduct
   Sadachaar is the way a good person behaves.

22. D — A trained teacher or trusted adult
   An expert can prevent injury.

23. D — It helps us breathe well and stay calm
   Yoga calms the body and mind.

24. C — To avoid strain from wrong posture
   Experts correct mistakes.

25. C — Holding the breath for too long
   Never force the breath.

26. D — It stretches the back and shoulders and relaxes
   It gently stretches and relaxes.

27. D — It shows respect for the divine in everyone
   Namaste honours the divine in others.

28. B — Balance, with wealth and wishes following Dharma
   Dharma guides the others.

29. A — Self-control
   It teaches self-control.

30. D — February or March
   Phalguna usually falls then.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: It tells us to respect and care for parents, teachers, family, friends, workers and helpers, and holy teachers, and they in turn care for us.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for naming groups, 1 mark for respect and care, 1 mark for mutual duty.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: People fast, keep an all-night vigil, bathe the Shiva Linga with water and milk, offer bel leaves, chant Om Namah Shivaya and visit the Mandir.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct practice.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: Enlightened Beings teach kindness and Ahimsa, so we should not harm others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for kindness or Ahimsa, 1 mark for a link to bullying.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: May any harm I did in thought, word or deed be forgiven.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for forgiveness.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: Any four of: Prithvi (earth), Jal (water), Agni (fire), Vayu (air), Akash (space).
   Working / marking points: Half a mark for each correct element, up to 2 marks.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: They grow it in a pot or a stand in the courtyard, water it every morning, walk around it and pray. Its leaves are offered to Vishnu and Krishna and used in home medicine.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct point, up to 3.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: Five great elements.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for five and 1 mark for great elements.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jains believe Lord Mahavir became fully enlightened while sitting on its bank, so the river is honoured in Jainism.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the Jain link, 1 mark for Lord Mahavir, 1 mark for enlightenment.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: Breathing exercises.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for breathing practice.

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: To join or unite the body, breath and mind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for join, 1 mark for the three things.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: Fast, stay awake all night, bathe the Shiva Linga, offer bel leaves, chant Om Namah Shivaya (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: A Jain teacher who shows people the path to freedom, like a guide across a river.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for teacher, 1 mark for showing the path.

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: A frightened dove flew into the king's lap and a hawk demanded it. The king offered his own flesh to save the dove. The lesson is that a kind person protects the weak.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the dove, 1 mark for the hawk, 1 mark for the offer, 1 mark for the lesson.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Closing taps, mending leaks, collecting rainwater, reusing water on plants, not polluting rivers (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible way.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Guru Amar Das Ji, the third Guru.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the name and 1 mark for third Guru.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Worshippers ring it gently to announce that they have arrived.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for ringing, 1 mark for announcing arrival.

47. (5 marks)
   Answer: Their lives show courage, kindness and truth. For example, Prahlad's faith and Siddhartha's kindness to the swan. People follow their example.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the reason, 2 marks for each example, up to 5.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: Daily prayers.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for daily and 1 mark for prayers.

49. (4 marks)
   Answer: Mercury is closest to the Sun; Mars is the red planet; Jupiter is the largest; Saturn has rings (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.
